name: 栖岚寺（暂名）
status: draft; not implemented; positions to be fixed after the first whitebox
units: metres; +x east; +z south (north/uphill is -z); y up
origin: the centre of the temple gate (山门), ground at 42 m above sea level (SRTM estimate)
height_note: ground_m is an SRTM estimate (±5-10 m); eye_m is above the local ground. Do not treat either as survey data.
season_time: proposal: winter clear morning (T01-J01), alternative late-autumn after rain (T01-J02)

cameras.name: 街边山门
cameras.purpose: city → temple; the gate holds the street; the pagoda is already visible above the roofs (as in the 2024 photo)
must_show: 武珞路路面/人行道/栏杆
门殿右上方的整座塔（或大半座）
must_not: 现代玻璃幕墙/赛博城市
cameras.notes: The 2024 photo shows the whole pagoda from across the street; keep it in frame, but do not let its eaves touch the gate ridge.

cameras.name: 放生池与圣僧桥
cameras.purpose: entering; water, bell/drum towers, the first courtyard
must_not: 把钟鼓楼做成山门两端的小楼
cameras.notes: Keep the city audible under the gate arch; do not silence it completely.

cameras.name: 大雄宝殿前
cameras.purpose: the third terrace; the five-bay hip roof; the pagoda is hidden here
must_show: 宽石阶、石栏与阶中石雕
重檐立面、竖匾「大雄寶殿」与横匾
must_not: 重檐七间（那是 T00 的大殿；这里是五间）
把大殿做成单檐平立面
cameras.notes: This is the 'the pagoda disappears' beat; verify that the hall and trees actually hide it.

cameras.name: 玉佛殿与后院
cameras.purpose: the fourth terrace; the two-storey Jade Buddha hall / library; the upper terraces begin
cameras.notes: The back courtyard is darker; add a believable eave bounce, not a global lift.

cameras.name: 法界宫与塔
cameras.purpose: the fifth/sixth terrace; the five-pavilion roof; the pagoda appears whole
must_not: 把五亭顶改成普通歇山
cameras.notes: The five-pavilion roof is the one building that should look foreign; keep its rotation.

cameras.name: 塔院与塔影田回望城市
cameras.purpose: the seventh terrace; the pagoda and the city behind the roofs
must_show: 层层屋顶（万佛殿、罗汉堂、玉佛殿、大雄宝殿）
cameras.notes: A second frame from the same spot, looking up at the pagoda, is expected for the pair.

three_reveals.amount: whole or most of it, far away
three_reveals.method: seen above the gate and roofs from across the street; the destination is announced
the gate, halls and ginkgo block it after entering
turn the corner on the upper terraces, no obstruction, ridge behind

to_verify_after_whitebox: every camera stands on walkable ground
the pagoda is never cut by the frame in cam06
the city skyline stays below the height controls (40/60 m above 1985 datum)
the five-pavilion roof reads at cam05
the street sound is still audible at cam02
the pagoda is not visible at cam03
